CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edit_post(p_post_id uuid, p_content text, p_title text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_description text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_tags text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_visibility text DEFAULT 'public'::text)
 RETURNS posts
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  updated_post posts;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE id = p_post_id AND user_id = auth.uid() AND is_deleted = false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Post not found or not owned';
  END IF;
  IF p_content IS NULL OR trim(p_content) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Content cannot be empty';
  END IF;
  UPDATE posts
  SET
    content = p_content,
    title = COALESCE(p_title, title),
    description = COALESCE(p_description, description),
    category = COALESCE(p_category, category),
    tags = COALESCE(p_tags, tags),
    visibility = COALESCE(p_visibility, visibility),
    edited_at = now(),
    version = version + 1
  WHERE id = p_post_id
  RETURNING * INTO updated_post;
  PERFORM parse_mentions(p_post_id, p_content);
  RETURN updated_post;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_posts(query text, limit_count integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, content text, created_at timestamp with time zone, display_name text, username text, avatar_url text, verified_status text, relevance real)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.title,
    p.content,
    p.created_at,
    pr.display_name,
    pr.username,
    pr.avatar_url,
    pr.verified_status,
    ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', p.title || ' ' || p.content), plainto_tsquery('english', query)) AS relevance
  FROM posts p
  LEFT JOIN profiles pr ON p.user_id = pr.id
  WHERE p.is_deleted = false
    AND p.visibility = 'public'
    AND to_tsvector('english', p.title || ' ' || p.content) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', query)
  ORDER BY relevance DESC
  LIMIT limit_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_suggestions(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, username text, display_name text, avatar_url text, verified boolean, verified_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT NULL::UUID, NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT, NULL::BOOLEAN, NULL::TEXT WHERE false;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.username,
    p.display_name,
    p.avatar_url,
    (p.verified_status IN ('verified','official','staff','business')) AS verified,
    p.verified_status
  FROM profiles p
  WHERE p.id != v_user_id
    AND p.is_private = false
    AND (p.show_in_suggestions IS NULL OR p.show_in_suggestions = true)   -- ✅ respect the toggle
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows WHERE follower_id = v_user_id AND following_id = p.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks WHERE blocker_id = v_user_id AND blocked_id = p.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dismissed_suggestions WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND dismissed_user_id = p.id)
  ORDER BY random()
  LIMIT p_limit
  OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_unread_message_count()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT count(*)::bigint
  FROM public.messages AS m
  WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND m.sender_id <> auth.uid()
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.message_reads AS mr
      WHERE mr.message_id = m.id
        AND mr.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.conversations AS c
        WHERE c.id = m.conversation_id
          AND (
            c.user1_id = auth.uid()
            OR c.user2_id = auth.uid()
          )
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.conversation_members AS cm
        WHERE cm.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
          AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
      )
    );
$function$

functions.name: get_unread_message_count
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_unread_message_count(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with user_conversations as (
    select c.id
    from public.conversations c
    where coalesce(c.is_note, false) = false
      and (
        (
          coalesce(c.is_group, false) = false
          and (c.user1_id = p_user_id or c.user2_id = p_user_id)
        )
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.conversation_members cm
          where cm.conversation_id = c.id
            and cm.user_id = p_user_id
        )
      )
  )
  select count(*)::bigint
  from public.messages m
  where m.conversation_id in (select id from user_conversations)
    and m.sender_id <> p_user_id
    and coalesce(m.is_system, false) = false
    and m.deleted_at is null
    and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.message_reads mr
      where mr.message_id = m.id
        and mr.user_id = p_user_id
    );
$function$

SELECT r.id AS repost_id,
    r.post_id,
    r.user_id AS reposter_id,
    r.comment AS repost_comment,
    r.created_at AS repost_created_at,
    reposter.display_name AS reposter_display_name,
    reposter.username AS reposter_username,
    reposter.avatar_url AS reposter_avatar_url,
    reposter.verified_status AS reposter_verified_status
   FROM reposts r
     JOIN profiles reposter ON reposter.id = r.user_id;
